title: Repository override (.dependency-agent.json)
description: Optional file at the root of a target repository. Merged over config/defaults.json and under the central per-repository 'overrides'. A repository can only make the agent stricter. IGNORED keys: ai.provider, ai.openAi, ai.copilot, ai.roslynk.* except 'enabled', ai.learnMcp.endpoint, gitIdentity, branchName. TIGHTEN-ONLY keys: guards.protectedPatterns (union with central), guards.maxChangedFiles and guards.maxChangedLines (lower of the two), ai.enabled, ai.learnMcp.enabled and ai.roslynk.enabled (can only turn off), ai.learnMcp.denyTerms (union). All other keys override the defaults. The file itself is a protected path: the agent never edits it.

targetFramework.description: Target framework moniker for modern .NET projects.

branchName.description: Branch the agent owns in each target repository. IGNORED in a repository file.

gitIdentity.description: Git author/committer identity used for agent commits. IGNORED in a repository file.

trackTargetMajorFor.description: Package id glob patterns (case-insensitive, * wildcard) whose major version must track the target framework major (e.g. Microsoft.Extensions.* -> 10.x for net10.0). Only applied when the package publishes a version with that major.

allowPrerelease.description: Allow prerelease versions. Default false: latest stable only.

pins.description: Exact version pins: package id -> version. Pinned packages are set to that version and never moved.

maxMajor.description: Maximum allowed major version per package id glob pattern, e.g. {"AutoMapper": 14}.

ignore.description: Package id glob patterns never touched.

filePatterns.description: File glob patterns treated as Dockerfiles.

solution.description: Solution or project to build, relative to the repository root. Null = auto-detect (single .sln/.slnx at root, else all projects).

runTests.description: Run dotnet test after a successful build.

failOnNewWarnings.description: Fail the run (draft PR) if the upgraded build has warnings not present in the baseline build.

buildArguments.description: Extra arguments appended to dotnet build, e.g. ["-p:ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true"].

testArguments.description: Extra arguments appended to dotnet test, e.g. ["--filter", "Category!=Integration"].

guards.description: Limits on what code fixers (rule-based and AI) may change.

maxChangedFiles.description: Max files changed by code fixes, excluding budgetExcludePatterns. In a repository file: effective value is the lower of central and repo.

maxChangedLines.description: Max added+removed lines from code fixes, excluding budgetExcludePatterns. In a repository file: effective value is the lower of central and repo.

budgetExcludePatterns.description: Files excluded from the change budget (manifest updates made by the deterministic updater).

allowedEditPatterns.description: Glob patterns code fixers may edit. Anything else is reverted.

protectedPatterns.description: Glob patterns code fixers may never edit. Union-merged: a repo file or override can add patterns but never remove them. In a repository file: unioned with the central list.

formatDiagnostics.description: Diagnostic IDs passed to dotnet format analyzers --diagnostics when present in build output.

rewriteRulesFile.description: Path (relative to the agent's config directory) of the declarative rewrite rules file.

enabled.description: Allow AI code fixing. In a repository file: can only turn AI off (false); true cannot enable AI that is disabled centrally.

provider.description: AI provider. IGNORED in a repository file.

model.description: Model name for any provider. Null = the provider's default (ai.copilot.model / ai.openAi.defaultModel).

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for any provider (none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Null = the provider's default (ai.copilot.reasoningEffort / ai.openAi.reasoningEffort).

timeoutMinutes.description: Wall-clock limit for a single AI provider invocation, in minutes.

copilot.description: GitHub Copilot CLI settings. IGNORED in a repository file.

executable.description: Copilot CLI executable name or path.

tokenVariable.description: Environment variable holding the GitHub token of a Copilot-licensed user.

model.description: Copilot model id used when ai.model is null. Confirm the exact id in the Copilot CLI model picker (/model) for the token's account.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort passed to the Copilot CLI (--reasoning-effort) when ai.reasoningEffort is null. Null = Copilot default.

openAi.description: OpenAI settings. IGNORED in a repository file.

endpoint.description: Optional base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Null = api.openai.com.

apiKeyVariable.description: Environment variable holding the API key.

defaultModel.description: Model used when ai.model is null.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for OpenAI reasoning models when ai.reasoningEffort is null. Null = model default.

learnMcp.description: Microsoft Learn MCP lookups through the local sanitizing proxy.

enabled.description: Allow documentation lookups. In a repository file: can only turn lookups off.

endpoint.description: Learn MCP endpoint. IGNORED in a repository file.

maxQueryLength.description: Maximum length of a sanitized query.

denyTerms.description: Extra terms (case-insensitive) that must never be sent, e.g. internal product or company names. Union-merged across layers. In a repository file: added to the central deny terms.

roslynk.description: Roslynk (https://github.com/mrpmorris/Roslynk): local Roslyn MCP server giving the AI compiler diagnostics, navigation and Roslyn code fixes. In a repository file only 'enabled' is allowed (can only turn Roslynk off).

enabled.description: Offer Roslynk tools to the AI. In a repository file: can only turn Roslynk off.

reviewers.description: Reviewer identities (Azure DevOps unique names or group descriptors) added as optional reviewers.

workItemIds.description: Work item ids to link to the PR.
